facts.fact: Rwanda has completed the transition of all domestic interoperable retail payments to eKash (RNDPS), and active mobile money accounts reached 8.56 million per RURA's Q1 2026 report.
Since 14 July 2026 customers can transfer between bank accounts and mobile wallets across institutions through eKash, with a maximum fee of Rwf20 per interoperable transaction.
Transfers between mobile money and banks are processed through a single national interoperable payment infrastructure operated by RSwitch.
